templates.name: Long Call
templates.description: Unlimited upside, limited downside. Best for strong bullish view.

templates.name: Short Put
templates.description: Collect premium; profit if price stays above strike.

templates.name: Bull Call Spread
templates.description: Buy ATM call, sell OTM call. Capped profit & loss.

templates.name: Bull Put Spread
templates.description: Sell ATM put, buy OTM put. Typically opened for a net credit.

templates.name: Call Ratio Back Spread
templates.description: Sell 1 ATM call, buy 2 OTM calls. Entry may be a credit or debit; upside is unlimited if the market rallies hard.

templates.name: Long Synthetic
templates.description: Buy ATM call + sell ATM put (same strike). Synthetic long futures — unlimited upside, with downside bounded when spot reaches zero.

templates.name: Range Forward
templates.description: Sell OTM put + buy OTM call. Bullish collar-style structure — limited downside via short put, unlimited upside via long call.

templates.name: Bullish Butterfly
templates.description: Call butterfly centred above spot — buy 1 ATM CE, sell 2 OTM CE, buy 1 further OTM CE. Max profit if spot rallies to the body strike.

templates.name: Bullish Condor
templates.description: Call condor above spot — profit zone sits over a range of higher strikes. Defined risk on both ends.

templates.name: Short Call
templates.description: Collect premium; profit if price stays below strike.

templates.name: Long Put
templates.description: Profit grows as spot falls but is capped at zero; loss is limited.

templates.name: Bear Call Spread
templates.description: Sell ATM call, buy OTM call. Typically opened for a net credit.

templates.name: Bear Put Spread
templates.description: Buy ATM put, sell OTM put. Capped profit & loss.

templates.name: Put Ratio Back Spread
templates.description: Sell 1 ATM put, buy 2 OTM puts. Entry may be a credit or debit; profit grows as spot falls but is capped at zero.

templates.name: Short Synthetic
templates.description: Sell ATM call + buy ATM put (same strike). Synthetic short futures — downside profit is capped at zero and upside loss is unlimited.

templates.name: Risk Reversal
templates.description: Buy OTM put + sell OTM call. Bearish collar — profits on downside, unlimited upside loss.

templates.name: Bearish Butterfly
templates.description: Put butterfly centred below spot — buy 1 ATM PE, sell 2 OTM PE, buy 1 further OTM PE. Max profit if spot falls to the body strike.

templates.name: Bearish Condor
templates.description: Put condor below spot — profit zone sits over a range of lower strikes. Defined risk on both ends.

templates.name: Long Straddle
templates.description: Buy ATM call + put. Profits from a large move either way.

templates.name: Short Straddle
templates.description: Sell ATM call + put. Profits if price stays pinned near strike.

templates.name: Long Strangle
templates.description: Buy OTM call + OTM put. Cheaper than straddle; needs bigger move.

templates.name: Short Strangle
templates.description: Sell OTM call + OTM put. Wider profit zone than short straddle.

templates.name: Jade Lizard
templates.description: Sell OTM put + short OTM call spread. No risk on upside if credit exceeds call-spread width.

templates.name: Reverse Jade Lizard
templates.description: Sell OTM call + short OTM put spread. No risk on downside if credit exceeds put-spread width.

templates.name: Call Ratio Spread
templates.description: Buy 1 ATM call, sell 2 OTM calls. Peak profit at short strike; unlimited upside loss above.

templates.name: Put Ratio Spread
templates.description: Buy 1 ATM put, sell 2 OTM puts. Peak profit at the short strike; loss below it is substantial but bounded at spot zero.

templates.name: Batman Strategy
templates.description: Call ratio spread (1×2) above + Put ratio spread (1×2) below. Two-eared "Batman" profile — peaks at the short strikes, with bounded left-tail loss at spot zero and unlimited right-tail loss.

templates.name: Long Iron Fly
templates.description: Short ATM straddle + long OTM wings. Max profit pinned at ATM.

templates.name: Short Iron Fly
templates.description: Long ATM straddle + short OTM wings. Max profit on a big move either way; max loss pinned at ATM.

templates.name: Double Fly
templates.description: Two iron butterflies — one centred below spot, one above. Eight legs total: short straddle at each body strike, long CE wing above and long PE wing below. Two profit peaks at the body strikes, defined risk on both ends.

templates.name: Long Iron Condor
templates.description: Bull put spread + bear call spread. Defined-risk range play.

templates.name: Short Iron Condor
templates.description: Reverse of long iron condor — long wings pay off on a big move either way, short body caps upside if spot pins in the middle.

templates.name: Double Condor
templates.description: Call condor + put condor at different strikes. Two wide profit plateaus on either side of spot.

templates.name: Call Calendar
templates.description: Sell near-expiry ATM CE, buy far-expiry ATM CE (same strike). The preview is illustrative: outcome depends on premiums, volatility, and the far leg’s residual time value.

templates.name: Put Calendar
templates.description: Sell near-expiry ATM PE, buy far-expiry ATM PE (same strike). The preview is illustrative because premiums, volatility, and residual time value determine the first-expiry result.

templates.name: Diagonal Calendar
templates.description: Sell near ATM CE and buy far OTM CE. The preview is illustrative because the far call retains residual time value at the first expiry.

templates.name: Call Butterfly
templates.description: Long call butterfly centred at ATM. Max profit if spot pins at the body strike.

templates.name: Put Butterfly
templates.description: Long put butterfly centred at ATM. Put-side mirror of the call butterfly.
